repo_grounded_facts.statement: SCS cumulative runoff: Q(P) = (P - Ia)^2 / (P - Ia + S) for P > Ia, else 0; S = 1000/CN - 10; Ia = 0.2 * S. Incremental runoff dQ_i = Q_i - Q_{i-1}; interval discharge q_i = (dQ_i / (t[i] - t[i-1])) * A * 645.33 cfs.
Discharge conversion: 1 in/hr of runoff over 1 sq mi = (1/12 ft/hr * 5280^2 ft^2) / 3600 s/hr = 645.333... cfs; the module uses the conventional rounded factor 645.33.
Manning face flux: q = sign(S) * (1/n) * hFlow^(5/3) * sqrt(|S|). Diffusivity D = h_flow^(5/3) / (n * sqrt(|S|)). Stability: dtSec <= dx^2 / (4 * D_max); SLOPE_FLOOR = 1e-12.

Freeboard margin arithmetic: freeboard = site elevation - BFE, rounded to 2 decimals. Bonebank: LAG freeboard 377.2 - 375.0 = +2.2 ft; FFE freeboard 382.5 - 375.0 = +7.5 ft; berm freeboard 379.8 - 375.0 = +4.8 ft.
H3 spatial indexes form a strict parent chain: res10 cell -> res8 parent -> res5 parent (validated with isValidCell).
